name: Apatouria
summary: The three days when Athens' phratries gather — feast, sacrifice to Zeus Phratrios and Athena Phratria, then the enrolment of children — running the same calendar stretch as the women's Thesmophoria, but at the clan shrines rather than the Thesmophorion.
testimonia: Herodotus 1.147 (the Apatouria as a mark of Ionian kinship, save Ephesus and Colophon)
Scholia to Aristophanes, Acharnians 146 (Dorpia, Anarrhysis, Koureotis)
